in_english.name: Mokhtar
in_english.meaning: Chosen, elected, selected, distinguished, chosen by Allah
in_english.long_meaning: Mokhtar is a name of great importance in Islam, derived from the Arabic root خطر, meaning to choose or select. In the Quran, the word Mukhtar is used to describe one who is chosen by Allah, as in Surah Al-Baqarah (2:216): "Do not take as friends those who have been given the Scripture and the unbelievers, and do not choose them as allies. And do not take as allies those who have been given the Scripture and the unbelievers, for they are like a wall that has been broken." In Islamic tradition, Mukhtar is also the name of a judge or a leader, and is considered an important title of honor and respect.
